pieces.name: main_gable
pieces.notes: big low-pitch (6/12) gable, ridge N-S at x 965 (LiDAR z 21), straight eaves at both ends, no hip diagonals visible; west face and east face each about 950 sqft.

pieces.name: se_cross
pieces.notes: small cross piece on the SE of the east face, ridge E-W about y 650 (LiDAR z 16), dark triangle at y 600-650 is its north face.

pieces.name: nw_wing
pieces.notes: NW wing, ridge E-W at y 508 (LiDAR z 17), dark north face, lit south wedge, valleys into the main west face at x 925; west hip end at x 738 under trees.

pieces.name: sw_piece
pieces.notes: small SW piece under the trees, LiDAR ridge z 14 at y 690, faces z 12; low confidence, mostly hidden by canopy.

exclude_notes: tree canopy over the west side
flat cover z 9 and tree shade between the NW wing and the SW piece
chimney and label box on the ridge
trace overshoots the south eave (eave at y 720)
notes: Simple big N-S gable with a NW hip wing, a small SE cross hip, and a tree-hidden SW piece. Confidence HIGH on the main gable and NW wing, LOW on the SW piece.
